metadata.title: Urban Night Portrait with Graffiti Jacket

retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic back-view portrait featuring a subject in a jacket with hand-painted graffiti, illuminated by high-contrast dual-tone red and blue lighting against a dark background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, back-facing shot of a person wearing a dark jacket with large, expressive graffiti lettering across the shoulders. The scene is set at night, using a 'teal and orange' or 'red and blue' lighting scheme where one side of the subject is hit with warm red light and the other with cool blue light, creating deep shadows and a gritty urban atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: Graffiti text integrated into jacket texture
Dark, underexposed background focusing attention on the jacket
coreInvariants: Subject's face is hidden from view
High-contrast red and blue rim lighting

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally positioned, filling the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large graffiti lettering on the back of the jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright graffiti, move up to the subject's hands/head, then to the top-aligned typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space at the top and sides to emphasize the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool blue/teal lighting on the right side
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm red/orange lighting on the left side
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the highlights with very low value (darkness) in the shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Thin stroke weight for the top text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Color split between words in the top line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Clean geometric sans-serif paired with raw, hand-drawn graffiti illustration.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, geometric, and modern feel of the top text.
Provides the necessary wide tracking and geometric clarity.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a back-view photo of a person in a dark jacket at night. Apply red light from the left and blue light from the right. Add hand-drawn marker graffiti to the back of the jacket.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay a single line of thin, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif text at the top center. Use white for the first half and red for the second half.

verificationChecks: Is the text tracking wide enough?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific brand logos on the jacket
Ensure the graffiti is an original illustration

avoid: Generic computer fonts for the graffiti

postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between subject and background
Verify the red/blue color split on the subject
Ensure the top text is perfectly centered
Confirm the graffiti follows the folds of the jacket
recipe.reuseFormula: Back-view urban portrait + dual-tone rim lighting + hand-drawn clothing graphics + wide-tracked minimalist typography.
